open_points.subject: M08 AdmissionVerdict
open_points.text: "trial_executions": the TrialExecutions (M07) this admission ran — one per active case;" + "Substitution: a verdict for the same implementation and corpus is the same verdict." + "every active case of the corpus is run again for the implementation at admission time"
open_points.question: Are TrialExecution references part of the AdmissionVerdict's value facts, or is the verdict uniquely the pair (implementation_id, corpus_digest) regardless of which TrialExecution records were produced on reruns?
options: TrialExecution references are part of verdict facts (then repeating admission over same implementation+corpus yields a different verdict value, so AdmissionVerdict behaves like an entity)
Verdict identity is only implementation_id+corpus_digest(+verdict/reason); TrialExecutions are auxiliary evidence not part of value identity
Kernel must never recompute admission for an already-seen implementation_id+corpus_digest and must return the existing verdict/evidence
open_points.default_guess: Treat AdmissionVerdict as uniquely keyed by implementation_id+corpus_digest and treat TrialExecutions as attached evidence, not identity facts.

open_points.subject: M10 ManifestOperation / M28 Installation (no selected instance)
open_points.text: M10: "base_url: the manifest's base URL of the one instance the installation selects for the service" and separately "required_headers, instance_class ... absent when the installation selects no instance"; M28: "its ManifestOperation then read without instance facts"
open_points.question: When no instance is selected for a service, is ManifestOperation still read, and if so is base_url absent as an instance fact (like required_headers/instance_class), or is ManifestOperation read refused altogether?
options: ManifestOperation is still read; base_url/required_headers/instance_class are all absent
ManifestOperation read is refused when no instance is selected
ManifestOperation is read with operation facts plus a non-instance base_url fallback
open_points.default_guess: Read ManifestOperation without any instance facts, including base_url absent.

open_points.subject: K-08 + M25 + M26 (draft-write authority and standing grants)
open_points.text: K-08: "a `draft-write` runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead"; M25: "A grant never covers a `destructive` node"; M26 authority: "the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send the flow activation..."
open_points.question: Can a StandingGrant be created for a draft-write node, and if yes does it have any authority effect on sends (or is draft-write always authorized only by flow activation except resend-after-not_applied)?
options: Draft-write nodes cannot be granted (grant action must refuse them)
Draft-write nodes may be granted but grants are inert; authority remains flow activation
Draft-write nodes may be granted and sends should record/use grant authority when active
open_points.default_guess: Allow grant records on draft-write but treat authority for normal draft-write sends as flow activation only.
